dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Sharp, high-contrast pale edges are visible on the margins of the folded flight feathers against darker feather bodies.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Indistinct; characterized by a gradual transition in scale size and color rather than a linear boundary.

other_distinctive_markers: A pervasive scalloped pattern across the entire dorsal surface created by dark feather centers and wide, pale gray fringes.
